{{Quote|I'm receiving their signal now, sir. They're Jedi.|The comm officer to Captain Hayle|<ref name="Part One" />}}
A [[New Republic]] '''comm officer''' served on a [[Defender-class cruiser|''Defender''-class cruiser]]. The officer notified [[Captain]] [[Hayle]] about an approaching [[Baylan's shuttle|ship]] that was carrying "[[Jedi]]." He was killed during the [[attack on the Vesper|attack on the ''Vesper'']].<ref name="Part One" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The comm officer first appeared in the [[Part One: Master and Apprentice|first episode]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka|Ahsoka]]'',<ref name="Part One" /> which released on [[August 22]], [[2023]].<ref name="Part One Release">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1692552080764887366|Star Wars|quote=Thank you to all the fans who celebrated with us at our @AhsokaOfficial fan events around the world last night! We're excited to announce that new episodes of #Ahsoka will now launch Tuesdays at 6PM PT, starting with our two-episode premiere on August 22, only on @DisneyPlus.|archivedate=20230818152836}}</ref> The comm officer was portrayed by [[P.J. Johal]].<ref name="Part One" />
